claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM the compound is unlikely to kill cells through opioid receptor antagonism; any weak, non-selective killing would most plausibly reflect a physicochemical/cytotoxic class effect shared with other cationic amphiphilic or lipophilic amines rather than a specific targeted mechanism.
